messages:
opsbot: PAGER — Severity P2: GPU inference queue growth exceeding 95% capacity in eu-west-1. Autoscaling: HPA not increasing replicas. Affected service: /inference-runtime. Please ack and triage.

alice (oncall-sre): acked. looking... pulling metrics now.

alice (oncall-sre): grafana: pod queue length moving from 20 -> 420 in last 8m. 95th latency spiking to 6s.

ben (runtime): thx. are we hitting pod count cap on the nodepool?

carol (infra): checking cluster quotas and autoscaler. one sec.

carol (infra): cluster autoscaler reports: "max nodes reached for nodegroup-gpu-1 (max=50)". Kubernetes shows 48 nodes currently.

ben (runtime): that explains capacity. why didn't HPA scale earlier? it should scale by custom metric (queue_length).

alice (oncall-sre): kubectl get hpa -n inference runtime-hpa -> currentReplicas=240 desiredReplicas=240 maxReplicas=240 targetMetricValue=1000 queue metric healthy?

alice (oncall-sre): looking at metrics adapter logs: repeat errors "unable to fetch custom metrics: connection refused" starting ~10:32 UTC.

opsbot: Note: incident-bot posted on-call rotation. New assignee: alice (oncall-sre).

ben (runtime): @eve can you check Prometheus scrape/ingest for custom metric namespace?

eve (metrics): on it. seeing a backlog in Prometheus remote-write, retention spikes. Several scrape jobs timing out to the metrics-adapter endpoint.

alice (oncall-sre): hypothesis: Prometheus -> metrics-adapter -> HPA pipeline lagged/broken, HPA couldn't see queue metric so stayed at maxReplicas and cluster autoscaler hit nodegroup max -> queue growth -> throttling.

david (prod-support): Customer impact check: some large customers report increased 503s and degraded throughput. CS pinged.

maria (customer-success): notified top-10 customers via status page; listing impacted tenants in DMs. 3 support tickets opened so far.

carol (infra): temporary mitigation options: 1) increase nodegroup max 2) manual scale up nodepool 3) cordon empty nodes? prefer 1 or 2 for speed.

ben (runtime): short-term safer: manually scale inference deployment to +30 replicas to drain queue while infra scales nodes. but we may blow past quota.

alice (oncall-sre): plan: (A) restart metrics-adapter to restore custom metrics feed (B) force Prometheus scrape retries (C) request infra to bump nodegroup max by 20 as emergency allowance (D) manual scale pod replicas if needed.

eve (metrics): restarting metrics-adapter now. command: ``kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deployment/custom-metrics-adapter``

opsbot: deployment/custom-metrics-adapter rollout restart triggered by eve at 10:45 UTC.

eve (metrics): adapter logs show startup errors around cert rotation, fixed by restart. now exposing metrics on /metrics and custom-metrics endpoint OK.

alice (oncall-sre): requery HPA metrics: `kubectl get --raw /apis/custom.metrics.k8s.io/v1beta1` -> now returning queue_length. HPA controller should reevaluate.

ben (runtime): HPA now sees metrics; desiredReplicas jumped to 310 but nodegroup capped at 240 -> pending scale.

carol (infra): requested CloudOps to increase nodegroup-gpu-1 max nodes to 80. Request ticket #CO-7845.

carol (infra): CloudOps acknowledged, ETA ~9m for capacity increase.

alice (oncall-sre): manual scale to hold immediate load: `kubectl scale deployment inference-runtime --replicas=320 -n inference` (executed). This will create pending pods until nodes available; some pods remain Pending.

ben (runtime): enabling burst routing fallback to smaller model instances for non-critical tenants to reduce GPU memory pressure. Config change applied to traffic router.

maria (customer-success): update: one enterprise tenant reported partial recovery in last 2m. latency dropping to ~1.2s for some requests.

david (prod-support): still seeing 503s from older requests hitting throttling codepath. queue drain rate improving but not there yet.

opsbot: Pager update: Severity remains P2. Current customer impact: degraded throughput for some tenants; manual mitigation in progress.

alice (oncall-sre): monitoring queue rate. good signal: queue length peaked 480 -> now 130 over 18m. 95th latency down to 2.1s.

carol (infra): CloudOps increased nodegroup limit; autoscaler now adding nodes. node count moving 48 -> 60 -> 72.

ben (runtime): pods transitioning from Pending -> Running as nodes come up. expected to finish in ~6m.

eve (metrics): follow-up: Prometheus remote_write backlog cleared after adapter restart; scrape interval for critical exporter temporarily set to 15s (was 60s) to speed metric visibility. will revert to 60s after stabilization.

alice (oncall-sre): handoff note incoming in 15m to next oncall. Please log any open action items.

maria (customer-success): sending customer update: we've mitigated most impact; telling them we have follow-up postmortem and will share ETA for full root-cause.

ben (runtime): open action items: 1) add HPA fallback to use CPU when custom metric unavailable 2) add alert for metrics-adapter error spike 3) add autoscaler buffer/override for emergency scale 4) run chaos test where metrics pipeline has latency.

carol (infra): infra actions: 1) add guardrail to allow emergency burst increases via CloudOps playbook 2) review nodegroup scaling latencies and warm pools.

eve (metrics): metrics actions: 1) add retry/backpressure smoothing to remote_write 2) ensure cert rotation for metrics-adapter is covered in deploy pipeline 3) add synthetic test to ensure custom metric visibility for HPA.

alice (oncall-sre): creating incident ticket and postmortem template now: INC-2026-318. I'll hand off to ben at 11:00 UTC for follow-up. leaving summary below.

alice (oncall-sre): SUMMARY (for handoff): timeline: queue grew after metrics-adapter lost connectivity to Prometheus -> HPA couldn't read custom queue metric -> HPA stayed at maxReplicas -> cluster autoscaler hit nodegroup max -> queue continued to grow -> restart metrics-adapter + emergency nodegroup increase + manual scale + routing fallback mitigated. Customer impact: degraded throughput and 503s for subset of tenants for ~28m. Next steps: postmortem + followups (ben/eve/carol).

opsbot: On-call handoff: alice (oncall-sre) -> ben (runtime) at 11:00 UTC.

ben (runtime): taking handoff. will coordinate postmortem. adding notes to INC-2026-318. thanks all. :thumbsup:

maria (customer-success): will prepare customer-facing RCA draft and coordinate distribution post-postmortem.

alice (oncall-sre): thanks team. leaving channel.

opsbot: Incident thread closed for on-call, transitioning to post-incident workspace. Remember to fill the postmortem checklist.
